title: Can LLMs Reliably Grade Olympiad Proofs? A Study of Mathematical Verification with LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.36767v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have made remarkable progress on solving competition-level mathematics, yet their ability to verify natural-language mathematical proofs remains relatively underexplored. This gap is especially pronounced for Olympiad-level proofs, which require meticulous assessment of each claim in a long reasoning chain. Current proof verification thus primarily relies on expert inspection, which is costly to scale. In this paper, we present a systematic study of LLM-based verification in this setting. Specifically, we introduce a human-curated dataset of USAMO 2025 candidate solutions with expert grading, and conduct a broad evaluation of existing LLM verifiers across frontier models. We also propose TROJAN, an iterative self-critique pipeline for generating high-fidelity adversarial proofs at scale. translated_title: 大语言模型能否可靠地评判奥赛证明？基于大语言模型的数学验证研究
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在解决竞赛级数学问题上取得了显著进展，但它们验证自然语言数学证明的能力仍相对缺乏深入研究。这一差距在奥赛级证明上尤为突出，因为奥赛级证明需要对长推理链中的每一个论断进行细致评估。因此，目前的证明验证主要依赖专家审查，而这种方式难以规模化扩展。在本文中，我们对该场景下基于大语言模型的验证进行了系统性研究。具体而言，我们引入了一个由人工整理并附有专家评分的USAMO 2025候选解答数据集，并对前沿模型中现有的LLM验证器进行了广泛评估。我们还提出了TROJAN，一个用于大规模生成高保真对抗性证明的迭代式自我批评流水线。我们的全面评估涵盖20个模型，涉及七项指标、两种提示风格、三种推理方法以及三种（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文通过构建带专家评分的USAMO 2025人工标注数据集并提出TROJAN对抗性证明生成流水线，系统性地评估了大语言模型验证奥赛级数学证明的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a systematic study of LLM-based verification of Olympiad-level proofs, using a human-curated USAMO 2025 dataset with expert grading and TROJAN, an iterative self-critique pipeline for generating high-fidelity adversarial proofs at scale.
